_doc: English translation: the French text of the interface (as written in the code and the data) -> its English text. Format markers (%s, %d) keep their order.

strings.Deux joueurs sur le même écran: Two players on the same screen
strings.La partie est sauvegardée : tu pourras l: The game is saved: you can resume it from the title screen.
strings.Créatures, décors, sons et musiques : Do: Creatures, scenery, sounds and music: Dofus Retro, © Ankama
strings.Chaque profil garde sa progression et sa: Each profile keeps its own progress and game in progress.
strings.Sa progression (%d champions vaincus) et: Its progress (%d champions beaten) and its game in progress will be erased. This cannot be undone.
strings.Rejoindre le Discord : les autres jeux r: Join the Discord: the other retro games, news, bugs to report, ideas
strings.Auto dessine le jeu à la résolution de t: Auto draws the game at your screen's own resolution. Performance mode draws it at 720p at most,
strings.sans la vie autour du plateau ni la tran: without the life around the board or see-through pieces, and with fewer interface animations.
strings.Les déplacements et attaques des créatur: Creature moves and attacks keep the speed set in “Game”.
strings.Au clavier : flèches et Entrée ; à la ma: Keyboard: arrows and Enter; controller: D-pad and A; Esc or B to go back.
strings.Recentrer la vue (Origine) · clic droit: Recentre the view (Home) · right-drag upwards: stand up to look down on the board
strings.Affiche à travers les autres les pièces: Shows pieces hidden behind a creature through it
strings.La partie en cours sera perdue et une no: The current game will be lost and a new one will start on this board.
The game will count as a loss.
The game is saved after every move.
strings.Ton pion a traversé le plateau : choisis: Your pawn crossed the board: choose its new form.
strings.Il apprend encore les règles… et compte: He is still learning the rules… and counts on the Pious to help him.
strings.Il joue lentement, entre deux siestes à: He plays slowly, between naps in the shade of the great trees.
strings.Patient comme la marée, il attend qu'une: Patient as the tide, he waits for a piece to be left undefended.
strings.Elle ramasse tout ce qui traîne : survei: She picks up anything left lying around: watch your pawns.
strings.Le meilleur joueur du village. Il connaî: The best player in the village. He knows a few classic traps.
strings.Solide comme la roche, il adore les tour: Solid as rock, he loves rooks and open files.
strings.Ses attaques surgissent de la brume, san: Her attacks rise out of the mist without warning.
strings.Froid et méthodique, il ne laisse rien p: Cold and methodical, he lets nothing slip.
strings.Calculs glacés et plans à long terme : l: Icy calculation and long-term plans: patience is her strength.
strings.Le dernier champion. Rares sont ceux qui: The last champion. Few have left his moor victorious.
strings.Choisis le plateau et la force de ton ad: Choose the board and your opponent's strength
strings.Tous les champions sont vaincus : choisi: Every champion is beaten: choose your board and your opponent's strength.
strings.Le jeu va se fermer, installer la mise à: The game will close, install the update and restart by itself.
strings.Le programme d'installation d'Android va: Android's installer will open: confirm the installation.
strings.Téléchargement impossible. Vérifie ta co: Download failed. Check your connection and try again.
strings.Installation impossible. La page de télé: Installation failed. The download page will open.
strings.Affronte un ami à distance avec un code: Play a friend at a distance with a code to share
strings.Ton ami te donne le code de sa partie :: Your friend gives you their game's code: type it here. No time limit between moves.
strings.Envoie ce code à ton adversaire : la par: Send this code to your opponent: the game starts as soon as they enter it in “Online”.
strings.Aucune partie avec ce code : vérifie-le: No game with this code: check it with your friend.
This game already has its two players.
strings.Ta version du jeu et celle du serveur ne: Your version of the game does not match the server's: update the game.
strings.Impossible de joindre le serveur : vérif: Cannot reach the server: check your Internet connection.
Your opponent will win the game.
strings.Quitter la partie en ligne compte comme: Leaving the online game counts as resigning.
strings.Partie en ligne : sans limite de temps e: Online game: no time limit between moves.
The connection to the server was lost.
strings.%s s'est déconnecté : la partie reprendr: %s disconnected: the game will resume when they are back.
strings.Retro Chess est un jeu de fan gratuit, f: Retro Chess is a free fan game, made for the love of it, with no commercial aim, and not affiliated with Ankama.
strings.Les créatures, les décors, les sons et l: The creatures, scenery, sounds and music come from Dofus Retro. Thank you to Ankama and its artists for a world that has been with us for years.
strings.Le moteur d'échecs libre (GPLv3) qui cal: The free chess engine (GPLv3) that computes the opponents' moves. Thank you to its many contributors.
strings.Le moteur de jeu libre (MIT) avec lequel: The free game engine (MIT) Retro Chess is made with.
strings.Les polices du jeu (SIL Open Font Licens: The game's fonts (SIL Open Font License).
strings.Le code du jeu est ouvert : réutilisable: The game's code is open: free to reuse, crediting its authors.
strings.Sa base de parties ouverte (domaine publ: Its open game database (public domain) was the reference used to tune the opponents' mistakes. Thank you for this free and open site.
strings.Pas fan des monstres ? Choisis tes pièce: Not fond of the monsters? Pick your pieces:
